result.stdout:
Quality Dashboard: consolidates SonarQube and OWASP ZAP results into a one-page report.

Usage:
  quality-dashboard --config <file> [options]
  quality-dashboard --demo [options]

(When run from a published exe, use QualityDashboard.exe in place of quality-dashboard.)

Options:
  --config <file>        Dashboard config (JSON). Required unless --demo.
  --out <dir>            Output folder (default: ./out)
  --format <list>        Comma-separated: html,pdf,docx,json (default: html,pdf,docx)
  --file-name <name>     Output file name without extension (default: quality-dashboard)
  --zap-root <dir>       Folder that relative zapReport paths resolve against
                         (default: the config file's folder)
  --browser-path <exe>   Edge/Chrome used for PDF output (default: auto-detect,
                         or QD_BROWSER_PATH)
  --history-db <file>    SQLite file that stores ZAP results for trends
                         (default: config historyDb, else
                         %APPDATA%\QualityDashboard\history.db)
  --no-history           Don't read or write the history database
  --demo                 Use built-in sample data (no SonarQube needed)
  --version              Show the version
  -h, --help             Show this help

The SonarQube token is read from the environment variable named in config
(sonar.tokenEnv, default SONAR_TOKEN).

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 invalid arguments/config, all projects failed, or an output failed.
